title: Eternal fires and easier storage
changes: Torches and other fueled fires stay lit without repeated manual refilling.
The manual auto-store command now reaches matching storage, including ItemDrawers, within 20 meters instead of 5 meters.
ItemDrawers keeps Shift+E for deposit all. The AzuCraftyBoxes chest inclusion toggle moves to Alt+C to remove the conflict.
Install the complete Ragnavik 1.1.60 profile rather than updating individual mods.
